crossRefs.note: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.
He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
“Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.
You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.
For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…
The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor…
Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.
But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as…
The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone…
The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.
and the dust returns to the earth as it was, and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
“Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher. “All is vanity!”
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…
For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with…
The voice of one saying, “Cry!” One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the…
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower…

translations.web: But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;
translations.bsb: What I am saying, brothers, is that the time is short. From now on those who have wives should live as if they had none;
translations.kjv: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
translations.asv: But this I say, brethren, the time is shortened, that henceforth both those that have wives may be as though they had none;
